slidemaster.edit.insert-master.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no Insert Slide Master (a deck keeps the masters its file has; Browse for Themes can bring a template's).

slidemaster.edit.rename.note: U:prism/masters: opens Rename Layout (dialog.renameLayout) on the open layout.

slidemaster.edit.insert-layout.note: U:prism/masters: a new custom layout after the open one, with a title placeholder, which becomes the open layout.

slidemaster.edit.delete.note: U:prism/masters: deletes the open layout; refused while slides use it or it is the last one.

slidemaster.edit.preserve.note: U:prism/masters: keep the master or layout even when no slide uses it.

slidemaster.layout.master-layout.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no Master Layout dialog; its Title and Footers check boxes beside it do the same.

slidemaster.layout.title.note: U:prism/masters: show or hide the Title placeholder of the open master or layout.

slidemaster.layout.footers.note: U:prism/masters: show or hide the date, footer and slide number placeholders of the open master or layout.

slidemaster.layout.insert-placeholder.note: U:prism/masters: adds a Content, Text, Picture, Chart, Table or Media placeholder to the open layout.

slidemaster.theme.themes.browse-for-them.note: U:prism/masters: the same as Design > Browse for Themes.

slidemaster.background.styles.note: U:prism/masters: Format Background for the open master, layout, handout or notes master.

handoutmaster.background.styles.note: U:prism/masters: Format Background for the open master, layout, handout or notes master.

notesmaster.background.styles.note: U:prism/masters: Format Background for the open master, layout, handout or notes master.

handoutmaster.setup.orientation.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no page orientation setting.

notesmaster.setup.orientation.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no page orientation setting.

handoutmaster.setup.per-page.note: U:prism/masters: how many slides a handout page holds (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9); kept with the open window.

handoutmaster.placeholders.header.note: U:prism/masters: show or hide this placeholder of the master.

handoutmaster.placeholders.date.note: U:prism/masters: show or hide this placeholder of the master.

handoutmaster.placeholders.footer.note: U:prism/masters: show or hide this placeholder of the master.

handoutmaster.placeholders.pageNumber.note: U:prism/masters: show or hide this placeholder of the master.

notesmaster.placeholders.header.note: U:prism/masters: show or hide this placeholder of the master.

notesmaster.placeholders.slideImage.note: U:prism/masters: show or hide this placeholder of the master.

notesmaster.placeholders.footer.note: U:prism/masters: show or hide this placeholder of the master.

notesmaster.placeholders.date.note: U:prism/masters: show or hide this placeholder of the master.

notesmaster.placeholders.body.note: U:prism/masters: show or hide this placeholder of the master.

notesmaster.placeholders.pageNumber.note: U:prism/masters: show or hide this placeholder of the master.
